title: Rueben Bain: My motivation is myself, not what draft pick I was

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rueben Bain: My motivation is myself, not what draft pick I was
sources.description: It wasn't hard to find mock drafts predicting edge rusher Rueben Bain would be off the board in the first 10 picks, but it wound up being a little later in the first round before his name was called.
